title: The archive
starting_code: # Down the archive waits an unlocked door, a key, and a locked door.
hints: Walk to the first door and tell it to `open` using its name, `archive_door`.
Walk to the key and pick it up.
Walk to the second door and use its own name, `vault_door`, to open it.
intro: The archive runs down from here. There are two doors here, so they have different names: `archive_door` and `vault_door`.
outro: You have a good memory for names. That will help you greatly with your magic.
learned: Now you know how to tell apart two doors by their names.
